subject.title: fix(codex): clean final/yield turn close writes a false "user interrupted" marker into the thread rollout

question: Should explicit `final:true` and `sessions_yield` wait up to 10 seconds for Codex’s natural `turn/completed`, while interrupting immediately when a new inbound user message arrives?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent and proved against a real app-server, but the deadline length, post-final settlement period, and user-input precedence are deliberate terminal-close policy choices rather than a uniquely dictated bug repair.

options.title: Adopt bounded natural completion
options.body: Accept the 10-second absolute deadline and immediate-new-inbound interrupt policy, then require a clean rebase and fresh exact-head proof.

options.title: Keep immediate interruption
options.body: Retain current hard-stop behavior and accept that Codex records an interruption marker on clean explicit-final/yield closes.

options.title: Choose different terminal policy
options.body: Set a different grace duration or inbound-message policy and ask for a narrow revision around the existing lifecycle seam.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded natural completion
recommendation.body: Accept the 10-second absolute deadline and immediate-new-inbound interrupt policy, then require a clean rebase and fresh exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged source-reply finalization work makes this person the closest available owner for the terminal settlement semantics.
